hypothesis: The clean Blood tank window does not prove a Blood priority or eligibility edge. The first broken edge is the role-calibration aggregate contract: an explicitly non-comparable tank/healer reference remains a role failure but must not be counted as a numerical hard-floor failure or optimization backlog item.
forbidden_changes: Do not change WoWSims or reference catalog data.
Do not change the Blood SQL migration, native candidate comparator, spell coefficients, gear, stats, encounter behavior, route, target geometry or safety policy.
Do not make incompatible reference evidence pass actor or raid performance acceptance.
Do not remove Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
Do not close actor_30002 or any other open parent requirement from this contract change.
acceptance_conditions: An incompatible tank/healer record reports reference_conditions_not_comparable and does not report reference_hard_floor as its cause.
The role result remains non-passing, while hard-floor aggregation and optimization backlog logic treat the reference floor as not applicable.
A comparable tank record still applies the configured numerical floor and a below-floor comparable record fails it.
Threat aura, healer exposure, damage smoothing, defensive coverage and all other tank-specific checks remain enforced.
Independent review, gate-bearing build and one exact cleaned role run remain required; actor and raid acceptance remain separate.
